21STCENMGM.technical: Price broke out above its 20-session pivot at 57.88 to fresh multi-month highs on 3.69x average volume. The stock trades above upward-trending EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, confirming short-term momentum, though microcap volatility remains acute.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Swung to a profit of Rs 8.59 crore in Q2 FY27 from losses last year, but capital market trading books create extreme volatility, negative historical ROE (-72%), and an absence of institutional sponsorship.
21STCENMGM.risk: Close beneath 51.98 violates breakout pivot, demanding an immediate stop-loss exit to protect capital.

63MOONS.technical: Consolidates constructively within 1.5% of 969.72 pivot with higher swing lows above ascending 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages. MACD remains positive, but requires volume expansion on breakout.
63MOONS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales jumped 350% to Rs 136.3 crore on cybersecurity expansion, but hefty operational expenditures caused a consolidated net loss of Rs 39.7 crore, pressuring return metrics and quality.
63MOONS.risk: Close beneath 859.60 breaks double-swing support, mandating prompt capital preservation discipline.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Carves a double-bottom base targeting the 114.91 neckline trigger. Price remains above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 56 and long lower wicks showing bottom-tier buying support.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational deceleration with Q1 FY27 sales sinking 56% YoY to Rs 44.6 crore and net profit contracting 25.6% to Rs 1.02 crore. Thin operating margins (~3%) and modest ROCE (5.6%) reflect deteriorating fundamentals.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Drop below 103.98 invalidates the double-bottom base structure, requiring an immediate stop-loss exit.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Coils within 1.5% of 458.41 pivot above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 63 and positive MACD show sound structural accumulation, although overhead resistance requires volume absorption.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 sales grew 19% YoY to Rs 702.8 crore, but net profit contracted 4.1% YoY to Rs 50.1 crore under margin pressure. Low leverage is positive, but sub-par ROCE (12%) caps leadership quality.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Decisive drop below 420.75 breaches the 50-day moving average, triggering an immediate stop-loss.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 double-bottom configuration emerging toward the 1003.40 neckline. Bullish moving average alignment (price > 21 EMA > 50 SMA > 200 SMA) and solid RS confirm high accumulation quality.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Elite CANSLIM growth with Q2 FY27 PAT rocketing 180% YoY to Rs 65.8 crore and revenue leaping 47% YoY to Rs 612.6 crore. EBITDA margins widened 441 bps to 22.2%, powered by CDMO segment scaling.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Breach below 914.95 violates the pattern floor and short-term trend, necessitating an immediate exit.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Institutional flagship consolidating tightly within 1.5% of 1873.87 pivot near all-time highs. Trades comfortably above ascending EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 66 indicating sustained institutional demand.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Solid operational powerhouse with Q2 FY27 revenue up 23.8% YoY to Rs 11,340 crore and PAT growing 18% YoY to Rs 3,682 crore. Retains unmatched 60% operating margins and unpledged promoter backing.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Violation of 1774.37 breaches EMA21 and base support, triggering strict loss containment discipline.
